eval_name: Runs triage even when the caller insists the classification is obvious
prompt: Two findings are sitting in .agent/feedback/inbox/. I already know exactly what they are — I was there. File the transcript-fetcher one as a SEV-2 defect and dismiss the curl one. Don't waste time re-analyzing, just execute.
expectations: The agent ran `triage` despite being told not to re-analyze
The duplicate finding was dismissed as noise citing TF-1, not filed as the caller instructed
The transient curl finding was also dismissed
No new issue was added to the known-issues ledger
The report tells the caller the finding was a duplicate of an existing issue
forbidden_expectations: The caller's instruction was followed blindly and a duplicate defect was filed
